title: The repository binding had no remote URL, which the workspace prepare takes from it and the SCM port cannot resolve from the opaque repository identifier
resolution: RemoteUrl, HTTPS without user information, is required in the binding input and output; design decision 11 and contract page section 4; tests failed before

title: BranchName allowed only printable ASCII up to 255 characters, so it refused valid Git branch names such as a Cyrillic release branch
resolution: BranchName follows git check-ref-format --branch, compared against Git 2.43; the 1024 bound is justified in its description and decision 11; a test failed before

title: The spec and contract page offered the operator bearer on every mutation but the receiver, although logIn and logOut accept only the cookie with CSRF
resolution: The requirement, its scenario, and contract page section 2 exclude logIn and logOut from the bearer; a test pins which mutations declare it

title: Authentication before reading the body was required of every operation, which the webhook receiver cannot meet because its signature covers the raw body
resolution: The order is limited to session and bearer operations; the receiver reads bounded raw bytes, then verifies, then parses, in the spec and contract page sections 2 and 5

title: Every project update was said to be compare-and-set, though member assignment and removal and the first binding carry no expected revision
resolution: The spec names the compare-and-set operations and the exceptions, with a scenario for concurrent assignments; contract page section 4 lists all of them

title: The 100-item paging rule covered every list, contradicting the unpaged listWorkers snapshot of design decision 17
resolution: The requirement, its scenario, and contract page section 6 exclude listWorkers; a test checks that every other list takes after

title: The cookie scheme description implied that the __Host- prefix also enforces HttpOnly and SameSite
resolution: The description now says the prefix enforces Secure, Path=/, and no Domain, and the server alone sets HttpOnly and SameSite, as design decision 4 does

title: Design decision 19 omitted that a login name starts with a letter or digit, as the LoginName schema requires
resolution: Decision 19 states the first-character rule

title: The record credited the coordinator with authorizing elevated review effort, which governance Routed effort leaves to an owner-approved governance change
resolution: The limitation now says the elevated efforts wait for that governance change and the authorized efforts stay: A medium, B high

title: A maintainer can bind any remote URL, so each run sends its SCM credential to a host that the integration does not confirm
resolution: Architect option (a): an installation-owner sets the integration's allowed origin; bindRepository refuses other origins with a typed 422, and every credential issue re-checks it

title: Member assignment was called idempotent while a different role replaces the old one, against product ports section 2 rule 7
resolution: Idempotent is dropped; design decision 7, the page, and the document state last-writer-wins as an explicit, reasoned exception to rule 7

title: The revoked token state had no redemption rule, and revoking an expired token had no defined answer
resolution: Redemption treats a revoked token as token-invalid, an obligation on item 26 (26c), which owns the enrollment endpoint; revoking a revoked or expired token answers 204

title: Logged requests relied on shape-based redaction that misses the cookie, the CSRF token, and write-only bodies
resolution: Request logs hold only allowlisted parts, never a write-only body or the Cookie, X-CSRF-Token, or Authorization header; spec, page, decision 20

title: The bindRepository 422 for an unreachable repository had no source, and an undeclared merge method had no answer
resolution: The 422 now refuses a merge method the plugin does not declare, grounded in source control sections 2 and 4; the reachability check is removed

title: The webhook 401 was a plain Failure with no fixed reason, and the access failure rule and its test silently left it out
resolution: The receiver answers 401 WebhookRejection with reason signature-invalid; the spec names the exception and the test checks the receiver

title: The logOut 401 named the operator credential, which logOut does not accept
resolution: The description now names only the session cookie

title: The rotateSlotCredential 200 promised a credential version the slot record lacks and left the returned revision open
resolution: The description now says the slot is returned as read after the final revision advance of account pool section 8.1, without a version

title: Five update operations gave a 409 for an existing resource, which no update can cause
resolution: The 409 of the five updates now says only that the expected revision is not the current one

title: Eight operations with an identifier path parameter declared no 400
resolution: The eight operations declare 400, and a new test checks every operation with a path parameter except the receiver

title: The roles requirement gave installation-owner all of project members, listing included
resolution: The requirement now says assigning and removing project members

title: The slot requirement put adding a slot under compare-and-set, and the SCM requirement omitted the compare-and-set of its change
resolution: The slot requirement names the commands that compare-and-set, and the SCM requirement adds the compare-and-set of a change

title: A revocation that lost to a rotation answered 204 while the replacement token stayed redeemable
resolution: Revoking a token that a rotation replaced answers 422 token-rotated and names the replacement in its details

title: A verified webhook delivery whose payload does not parse had no defined answer
resolution: It answers 400 invalid and is not recorded, as source control section 2 rule 5 maps a malformed request

title: The tests did not check no-store on readSession and logIn or the page bound and next identifier of the lists
resolution: New tests check no-store on both responses and maxItems 100 with an optional next Identifier on every paged list

title: The record named the wrong commit as the one whose tree the pass 1 fix run verified and omitted three commits
resolution: The Revision list names 13b9b2fb, 425a6ca9, and e9daeef1 and says the run checked 425a6ca9

title: The allowed and normalized origin patterns accepted a port above 65535 and malformed IPv6 literal hosts
resolution: Both origin patterns and RemoteUrl take a host name without IPv6 literal and a port from 1 to 65535, with negative tests for each
